data.one_liner: A collapsible sidebar widget optimized for web and desktop applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable and animated collapsible sidebar widget with support for items, child items, and header configurations. It handles selection state internally or externally and adapts well to different screen sizes.
use_when: You need a collapsible sidebar for a web or desktop Flutter application.
You want to organize navigation items with parent-child relationships in a sidebar.
avoid_when: You need a mobile-first bottom navigation or standard drawer paradigm.
You require complex navigation routing built directly into the widget.
strengths: Customizable header icon, text, and colors
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedSidebar(
  expanded: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width > 600,
  items: items,
  selectedIndex: 0,
  onItemSelected: (index) => print(index),
  headerIcon: Icons.ac_unit_sharp,
  headerIconColor: Colors.amberAccent,
  headerText: 'Example',
)
